profile.headline: Sr. Frontend Software Developer  at CVS Health
profile.summary:
Adaptive to emerging applications and technologies, solid understanding of designing and development of web technology.

Hands-on experience with SDLC - Requirement gathering, Designing, Development, Testing and Deployment.

Experience working in Health, Agriculture and client-based companies.

positions.title: UI/Frontend Developer/Software Engineer (Sr. Analyst)
positions.description:
Playing an integral role throughout the SDLC, including requirement gathering, designing, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

Part of Tier-3 production support team to analyze critical prod issues, finding the root cause and implementing the solution.

Created reusable UI components, routing Guards, directives, custom validations in reactive forms using angular.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: In Monsanto, As a Full stack developer, I worked in finance module. In CI/CD environment, I was involved to develop services in node.js,  designing/developing UI components and Testing

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As a Developer Worked with different clients to understand technical requirements for different projects and prepared the use cases for different functionalities and designs.

Developed jQuery and JavaScript code extensively for Document Object Model (DOM) manipulation and style sheets.

positions.title: Student Trainee
positions.description: During student trainee at iFlame, I learned core concept of Iphone/IOS app development using objective C and SQlite Database and created academic project.
